question.worked_solution:
We need to use integration by parts.

In this case, we define

$$
\begin{aligned}u={(\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2})}^{2}\, & ⟹\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=2\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2}\cdot \frac{1}{{x}^{2}}\cdot 2x=\frac{4\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2}}{x} \\ \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=4{x}^{2}\, & ⟹\,v=\int \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x=\int 4{x}^{2}\,\,\text{d}x=\frac{4{x}^{3}}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the formula of integration by parts, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 4{x}^{2}{(\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2})}^{2}\,\text{d}x & =\int u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =uv-\int v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={(\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2})}^{2}(\frac{4{x}^{3}}{3})-\int (\frac{4{x}^{3}}{3})(\frac{4\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2}}{x})\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{4{x}^{3}{(\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2})}^{2}}{3}-\frac{16}{3}\int {x}^{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2})\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

We use integration by parts once again to evaluate $\int {x}^{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2})\text{d}x.$ We take

$$
\begin{aligned}u=\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2})\, & ⟹\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=\frac{2}{x} \\ \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}={x}^{2}\, & ⟹\,v=\int \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x=\int {x}^{2}\,\text{d}x=\frac{{x}^{3}}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

In this case, the formula for integration by parts gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\int {x}^{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2})\,\text{d}x & =\int u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =uv-\int v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =(\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}))(\frac{{x}^{3}}{3})-\int (\frac{{x}^{3}}{3})(\frac{2}{x})\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{{x}^{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2})}{3}-\frac{2}{3}\int {x}^{2}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{{x}^{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2})}{3}-\frac{2{x}^{3}}{9}+D,\end{aligned}
$$

where $D$ is an integral constant.

So we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 4{x}^{2}{(\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2})}^{2}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{4{x}^{3}{(\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2})}^{2}}{3}-\frac{16}{3}(\frac{{x}^{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2})}{3}-\frac{2{x}^{3}}{9}+D) \\  & =\frac{4{x}^{3}{(\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2})}^{2}}{3}-\frac{16{x}^{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2})}{9}+\frac{32{x}^{3}}{27}-\frac{16D}{3} \\  & =\frac{4{x}^{3}}{27}(9{(\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2})}^{2}-12\operatorname{ln}⁡{x}^{2}+8)+C,\end{aligned}
$$

Where, $C=-\frac{16D}{3}.$
